name: paper-subscribe
title_zh: 订阅中心化论文日报，定时生成并投递本地摘要
tagline_zh: 每天自动拉取论文 feed，生成一份本地 digest 并按计划送达。适合固定时间刷论文、又不想被多源信息冲散注意。
tagline_en: Pull the daily paper feed, build a local digest, and get it delivered on schedule. For researchers who want one.
desc_en: Subscribe to the centrally generated paper-daily feed, prepare a local digest, and deliver it on a schedule.
why_zh: 它把『订阅-摘要-投递』做成闭环，不依赖任何外部推送服务，全部在本地跑，调度逻辑透明可改。
why_en: It closes the loop from feed to digest to delivery, all local and cron-driven — no cloud push, no opaque pipeline.
limit_zh: 只认 xianshang33/llm-paper-daily 这一个 feed 格式；摘要质量取决于上游。
limit_en: Only parses the llm-paper-daily feed format; digest quality depends on upstream; delivery is local commands only (mail/notify), no built-in SMTP/IMAP.
